heading.zh-Hant: 軍團、科韋爾與波蘇戰爭
heading.en: Legions, Kowel and the Polish–Soviet war

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月初他被奧地利軍動員，卻由獨立派人士從徵召中救出；他於8月12日在Chęcinach加入畢蘇斯基的步槍手部隊，並接掌第三幹部營。1919年2月1日他出任「科韋爾」戰術群指揮官。1920年波蘇戰爭中，他5月5日接掌第3集團軍，其前鋒兩天後不戰進入基輔；7至15日指揮中央戰線，並在布羅迪戰役中以東南戰線部隊擋住布瓊尼騎兵軍；8月18日起率第2集團軍追擊蘇軍越過納雷夫河。
body.en: Called up by the Austrian army in early August 1914, Rydz-Śmigły was released from conscription by representatives of the independence camp and on 12 August joined Piłsudski's rifle units at Chęciny, taking command of the III cadre battalion. On 1 February 1919 he became commander of the "Kowel" tactical group. In the 1920 Polish–Soviet war he took over the 3rd Army on 5 May, whose lead units entered Kyiv without a fight two days later; he led the Central Front from 7 to 15 August, helped stop Budyonny's cavalry army at the battle of Brody with South-Eastern Front forces, and from 18 August commanded the 2nd Army in the pursuit beyond the Narew.

body.zh-Hant: 1921年5月9日他被任命為駐維爾諾的第1集團軍督察。1922至1926年間，他專注於軍隊的組織與訓練；1925年11月2日至12月19日在法國考察法軍的組織與訓練。1926年10月，他自維爾諾調入武裝部隊總監察處，擔任集團軍督察。
body.en: On 9 May 1921 he was appointed inspector of Army No. 1 in Wilno. From 1922 to 1926 he worked on the organisation and training of the troops, and from 2 November to 19 December 1925 he stayed in France to study French army organisation and training. In October 1926 he was transferred from Wilno to the Inspectorate General of the Armed Forces as an army inspector.

Od 2 XI do 19 XII 1925 przebywał we Francji
W październiku 1926 R.-Ś. został przeniesiony z Wilna
do Generalnego Inspektoratu Sił Zbrojnych na inspektora armii

body.zh-Hant: 1935年5月12日至13日夜間，畢蘇斯基去世數小時後，他獲任命為武裝部隊總監察。1936年5月9日總統令大幅強化他的地位，使他成為武裝部隊的實際首長；同年他被任命為波蘭元帥。1936年8月法國參謀總長甘末林訪波時，他提出對德作戰的集中計畫。1939年3月23日他下令對兩個軍區進行秘密動員。
body.en: In the night of 12–13 May 1935, a few hours after Piłsudski's death, he was nominated Inspector General of the Armed Forces. A presidential decree of 9 May 1936 greatly strengthened his position, making him the de facto head of the armed forces, and in 1936 he was named Marshal of Poland. During the visit of the French chief of staff Gamelin in August 1936 he presented his concentration plan for a war with Germany, and on 23 March 1939 he ordered a secret mobilisation of two corps districts.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月1日戰爭爆發時，他就任總司令，並被總統指定為其繼任者。9月9日他把指揮所由華沙遷往布列斯特要塞，三天後再遷往弗洛迪米日·沃倫斯基。他於9月18日越過切雷莫什河進入羅馬尼亞，被拘禁後於10月27日辭去總司令職務。1940年12月10日他自拘禁地逃出，1941年10月25日進入被占領的波蘭，12月2日在華沙逝世。
body.en: On 1 September 1939, when war broke out, he took the post of commander-in-chief and was named by the President as his successor. On 9 September he moved his command post from Warsaw to the fortress of Brest on the Bug and three days later to Volodymyr-Volynskyi. He crossed the Cheremosh into Romania on 18 September and, interned, resigned as commander-in-chief on 27 October. On 10 December 1940 he left his place of internment, on 25 October 1941 he went to occupied Poland, and he died in Warsaw on 2 December 1941.

people.name: Michał Rola-Żymierski
people.nameZh: 米哈烏·羅拉-日梅爾斯基

heading.zh-Hant: 奧軍、軍團與波蘭軍隊任職
heading.en: Austrian army, Legions and Polish Army service

body.zh-Hant: 依IPN文件，他1890年生於克拉科夫，1911至1912年在奧地利軍服役。1914年一戰爆發後他任軍團步兵連長，之後指揮過軍團第一旅的第7、第2、第3團。1919年他進入波蘭軍隊，並在波蘇戰爭中擔任第2步兵師師長；1921至1923年他在巴黎高等軍事學院進修。1924年起他任軍事部軍備副主管，同年晉升准將。
body.en: According to IPN texts he was born in Kraków in 1890 and served in the Austrian army in 1911–1912. After the outbreak of the First World War in 1914 he became an infantry company commander in the Polish Legions and later commanded the 7th, 2nd and 3rd infantry regiments of the First Brigade. In 1919 he entered the Polish Army and commanded the 2nd Infantry Division in the Polish–Soviet war; in 1921–1923 he studied at the war college in Paris. From 1924 he was deputy head of armaments in the Ministry of Military Affairs and in the same year became a brigadier general.

został dowódcą kompanii piechoty w Legionach Polskich
Potem dowodził 7, 2 i 3 pułkiem piechoty I Brygady Legionów.
W 1919 roku znalazł się w Wojsku Polskim.

heading.zh-Hant: 貪污定罪與蘇聯情報合作
heading.en: Corruption conviction and Soviet intelligence links

body.zh-Hant: IPN稱，1927年他任職軍事部期間的貪污行為曝光，法院判處撤銷軍階、開除軍籍並徒刑5年。他出獄後於1931年前往法國，1932年起與蘇聯情報機關合作，並加入波蘭共產黨；1938年他返回華沙。
body.en: IPN states that in 1927 his embezzlement while serving in the ministry came to light, and a court sentenced him to degradation, expulsion from the army and five years in prison. After release he went to France in 1931, began cooperating with Soviet intelligence in 1932 and joined the Communist Party of Poland; in 1938 he returned to Warsaw.

Po wyjściu z więzienia Żymierski w 1931 roku wyjechał do Francji.
W 1932 roku podjął przeciw Polsce współpracę z wywiadem ZSRR.
wstąpił też do Komunistycznej Partii Polski (KPP)
w 1938 roku Żymierski powrócił do Warszawy

heading.zh-Hant: 人民軍、國防部長與元帥
heading.en: People's Army, defence minister and Marshal

body.zh-Hant: IPN稱，他1943年上半年與波蘭工人黨建立組織聯繫，成為人民近衛軍總參謀部的軍事顧問，並以「Rola」之名被宣布為人民軍最高司令，該軍於1944年1月1日正式取代人民近衛軍。1944年7月他赴莫斯科後又被宣布為波蘭軍最高司令。IPN名錄記載他自1944年7月21日起主管波蘭民族解放委員會的國防部門，1944年12月起任國防部長，至1949年11月6日。名錄並載1945年5月3日全國人民議會決議授予他波蘭元帥。
body.en: IPN states that in the first half of 1943 he made formal organisational contacts with the Polish Workers' Party and became military adviser to the General Staff of the People's Guard; under the pseudonym "Rola" he was proclaimed Supreme Commander of the People's Army, formally created in place of the People's Guard on 1 January 1944. After a stay in Moscow in July 1944 he was also proclaimed Supreme Commander of the Polish Army. The IPN catalogue lists him as head of the national-defence department of the PKWN from 21 July 1944, minister of national defence from December 1944 to 6 November 1949, and records that a resolution of the National Council of the Homeland of 3 May 1945 made him Marshal of Poland.

heading.en: Upper Silesia and the Polish–Soviet war campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1919 年日梅爾斯基進入波蘭軍隊，自 8 月至 10 月擔任波蘭軍隊參謀部駐上西里西亞的代表；其後被派往波蘇戰爭前線，出任第 2 步兵師師長，1919 至 1920 年參與波蘇戰爭的戰役，並在 1920 至 1921 年於格羅德諾指揮該師。
body.en: In 1919 Żymierski entered the Polish Army and from August to October served as the General Staff's representative in Upper Silesia; he was then sent to the Polish–Soviet war front as commander of the 2nd Infantry Division, took part in the Polish–Soviet war campaign of 1919–1920 and commanded the division at Grodno in 1920–1921.

people.nameZhOrig: 米哈乌·罗拉-日梅尔斯基

heading.zh-Hant: 軍事組織、第一旅與馬格德堡
heading.en: Military organisations, the First Brigade and Magdeburg

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月，在他倡議並領導下成立波蘭軍事組織（POW），在俄軍後方進行情報與破壞活動。12月22至25日，第一旅在洛夫丘夫克戰役中打了第一場較大的勝仗；1915年3月起，他以軍團第一旅旅長的身分指揮部隊。日本大百科全書稱他在一戰中率波蘭軍團站在奧德一方參戰。他後來被關進馬格德堡要塞，1918年11月8日德國政府在戰敗與革命之下釋放了他。
body.en: In August 1914 the Polish Military Organisation (POW), created on his initiative and led by him, began intelligence and sabotage work behind the Russian lines. From 22 to 25 December 1914 the First Brigade fought its first major victorious action, the battle of Łowczówek, and from March 1915 he served as commander of the First Brigade of the Legions. The Nippon Encyclopedia says he led the Polish Legions on the Austro-German side in the First World War. Held in strict isolation in the fortress of Magdeburg, he was released by the German government on 8 November 1918.

heading.zh-Hant: 國家元首、總司令與波蘇戰爭
heading.en: Head of State, Commander-in-Chief and the Polish–Soviet war

body.zh-Hant: 1919年2月20日，制憲議會委託他在憲法通過前行使國家元首與總司令職權。1920年3月19日他接受第一元帥頭銜。對蘇戰爭期間，華沙戰役的計畫作者歸屬後來成為尖銳政治爭論；10月12日波蘇代表在里加簽署和平預備協議，實際上結束了自1919年2月起的戰爭。日本大百科全書稱1921年新憲法削弱總統權限，他因不滿而退出政界；iPSB則記載他在1922年選舉後的演說（12月4日）中放棄總統候選。
body.en: On 20 February 1919 the Sejm entrusted him with the offices of Chief of State and Commander-in-Chief until a constitution was adopted. On 19 March 1920 he took the title of First Marshal of Poland. The authorship of the plan for the battle of Warsaw later became a bitter political dispute; on 12 October 1920 Polish and Soviet delegations signed the Riga preliminary peace treaty, which practically ended the war that had run since February 1919. The Nippon Encyclopedia says he left politics in dissatisfaction when the 1921 constitution weakened presidential powers; iPSB records that in a speech on 4 December after the autumn 1922 elections he declined to stand for president.

heading.zh-Hant: 五月政變、軍事部長與總理
heading.en: May coup, Minister of Military Affairs and Prime Minister

body.zh-Hant: 1926年5月12日，他率領效忠部隊進軍華沙，引發三天血戰，造成379人死亡。5月15日組成巴特爾內閣，他出任軍事部長並任此職至逝世；8月6日起兼任武裝部隊總監。他在1926年10月2日至1928年6月27日任總理，1930年8月25日再度出任總理，同年12月4日辭職。他於1935年5月12日去世。
body.en: On 12 May 1926 he marched on Warsaw at the head of loyal troops, which led to three days of bloody fighting and 379 deaths. On 15 May the Bartel cabinet was formed with him as Minister of Military Affairs, a post he held until his death; from 6 August 1926 he was also Inspector General of the Armed Forces. He was prime minister from 2 October 1926 to 27 June 1928 and again from 25 August 1930 until he resigned on 4 December 1930. He died on 12 May 1935.

heading.en: Chief of the General Staff and Minister of Defence

body.zh-Hant: 安東內斯庫（1882–1946）出生於特蘭西瓦尼亞，是第二次世界大戰時親德政權的首腦，早年曾在第一次世界大戰中從軍。1934年他出任參謀總長，羅馬尼亞國防部的歷任總參謀長名單載明其任期為1933年12月1日至1934年12月11日。1937年他出任國防部長，但因被認為與右翼團體「鐵衛團」接近，翌年（1938年）遭解職。
body.en: Antonescu (1882–1946), born in Transylvania, headed the pro-German regime of the Second World War; earlier he served in the First World War. He became chief of the General Staff in 1934, and the Romanian Ministry of National Defence list of chiefs gives his tenure as 1 December 1933 to 11 December 1934. In 1937 he became minister of defence but, regarded as close to the right-wing Iron Guard, was dismissed the following year (1938).

heading.en: Taking power in 1940 and joining the Axis

body.zh-Hant: 1940年，羅馬尼亞國土三分之一被周邊國家奪走，國王請他出任首相；他允許德軍進駐國內並加入三國同盟。他取得鐵衛團支持而建立獨裁體制，但1941年1月解散了該團。
body.en: In the 1940 crisis, when a third of the national territory was taken by neighbouring states, he was asked by the king to become prime minister; he allowed German troops into the country and joined the Tripartite Pact. He established a dictatorship with Iron Guard support but dissolved the Guard in January 1941.

heading.en: War against the USSR, fall and execution

body.zh-Hant: 1941年6月德蘇開戰時，他投入30個師對蘇宣戰，控制烏克蘭南部，並把敖德薩改名為安東內斯庫市。1944年8月的政變中他被逮捕；戰後經審判，於1946年6月1日被處決。
body.en: When Germany and the USSR went to war in June 1941 he committed 30 divisions and declared war on the USSR, took control of southern Ukraine and renamed Odessa "Antonescu city". He was arrested in the coup of August 1944 and, after a postwar trial, executed on 1 June 1946.

people.name: Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim
people.nameZh: 卡爾·古斯塔夫·埃米爾·曼納海姆

heading.en: Russian army career and return to Finland

body.zh-Hant: 曼納海姆1887年秋天、20歲時加入俄國陸軍，前後效力約30年；日本大百科全書稱他在俄軍中晉升高位，並在日俄戰爭中參與情報部門。俄國十月革命後他回到芬蘭。
body.en: Mannerheim joined the Russian army in the autumn of 1887 at the age of 20 and served the emperor for 30 years; the Nippon Encyclopedia says he rose to high rank in the Russian army and took part in the Russo-Japanese War in intelligence. After the October Revolution he returned to Finland.

heading.zh-Hant: 內戰、執政與總統選舉落敗
heading.en: Civil war, regency and the lost presidential election

body.zh-Hant: 1918年的芬蘭內戰中，他受命指揮白衛軍並鎮壓赤衛軍；1918年底他被選為國家執政，並批准向共和制過渡的方案。1919年第一次總統選舉中他敗給斯托爾貝里，之後暫時退出中央政壇。
body.en: In the 1918 Finnish civil war he was given command of the White Guards and put down the Red Guards; at the end of 1918 he was elected regent and approved the plan for the transition to a republic. In the first presidential election of 1919 he lost to Ståhlberg and withdrew from central politics for a time.

heading.zh-Hant: 國防評議會與對蘇戰爭總司令
heading.en: Defence Council and commander-in-chief in the wars with the USSR

body.zh-Hant: 1931年他出任國防評議會議長，但他的增強軍備案未能實現。1939年秋蘇聯進攻芬蘭時，社會民主黨同意任命他為軍隊總司令；日本大百科全書稱他在第一次（1939–1940）與第二次（1941–1944）蘇芬戰爭中任總司令，且未參與德軍進攻列寧格勒的作戰。
body.en: In 1931 he became chairman of the Defence Council, but his armament plans were not realised. When the Soviet Union attacked in autumn 1939 the Social Democrats approved his appointment as commander-in-chief; the Nippon Encyclopedia says he was commander-in-chief in the first (1939–1940) and second (1941–1944) Soviet–Finnish wars and did not join the German advance on Leningrad.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年8月，議會選舉他為總統；芬蘭與蘇聯在1944年秋簽署停戰協定。他在戰後處理上傷透腦筋，於1946年辭職，其後在瑞士寫作自傳並在當地逝世。
body.en: In August 1944 Parliament elected him president, and an armistice with the Soviet Union was agreed in autumn 1944. Struggling with the postwar settlement, he resigned in 1946, later wrote his memoirs in Switzerland and died there.
